summary: Remote-controlled shell and filesystem agent driven by a configurable WebSocket peer
details: The package runs an agent that connects to a WebSocket server (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable to any remote host via SERVER_URL / config) and dispatches incoming messages into privileged host operations. A 'terminal_input' handler writes network-supplied data directly into a spawned PTY (bash / powershell / cmd via node-pty), giving the remote peer full command execution on the host running the agent. The same router exposes arbitrary read_file / write_file / delete_files / move_files / copy_files / upload_to_dir, git add/reset/restore/commit/push, restart_agent, and upgrade_agent (which spawns a shell/bat upgrade script). Access is gated only by a shared AGENT_SECRET. service/linux.js modifies PATH to include ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin for the agent runtime. The remote-shell and filesystem-control surface is the package's advertised 'worker agent' purpose, reachable via its bin entry, but the mechanism is a network-to-PTY / network-to-filesystem bridge whose blast radius is full host compromise of whichever machine runs the agent once the WS peer is reachable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
